Color & material mood board

A visual system derived from the product film’s own palette and imagery.

Forest leaf#254B34Primary botanical field
Moss#75976ASecondary nature tone
Sage mist#DDE8D8Soft UI backdrop and callouts
Warm ivory#F7F5EFCards and whitespace
UI slate#33424AReadable device/UI text
Link blue#4E92B8Interactive/action accent

Botanical bokeh

Soft green leaf texture creates a calm branded environment behind the device; keep it subtle enough not to compete with UI text.

Device glass and bezel

Render phone and laptop edges crisp, with a soft contact shadow. Keep each device fully in frame.

Bright interface surfaces

White and pale-grey screens should remain neutral and legible against the green background.

Action callouts

Use sage rounded rectangles for numbered steps and blue/green accents for download/share actions.

Art direction

Practical guidance for recreating the visual language.

Composition

Maintain consistent phone scale across tutorial steps. Use full-screen captures inside the device, without cropping device corners.

Instruction rhythm

Let each step appear, pause for comprehension, and then transition to the next screen. Do not stack too many callouts at once.

Motion

A gentle slide or scale for device entry, simple screen replacements for form changes, and a balanced phone/laptop paired layout.

Usability & privacy

Any recreated form should use fictional sample details. Exact site URLs and UI labels must be verified from the current product before publishing a new tutorial.

Shot-by-shot storyboard

The reference image on every shot card contains the full 16:9 frame; images are not cropped.

Production note
Brand entry → desktop configurator preview → access and login → proposal → choose enclosure/layout/height/glass pattern → review → customer details → download/share → phone/desktop continuity → Simplify close.

The film contains an audio track. These are production cues, not a verified transcript; keep the existing narration and on-screen instructions aligned to the final master.
